status: Analysis only; no new implementation/build/run or profiler. Build193 outcome preserved and all owned handles terminal before review.
active_target: Speed of useful quality closure through the existing shared geometry-certification path. Positive net q/J yield does not establish eventual repair power. No new scheduler/construction fallback.

query_identity.exact_repeat: An exact union hit has the same immutable authority owner, ordered complete support IDs, tolerance and all physical-coordinate bits. It is already reused numerically.
query_identity.miss: A miss may be a new position, changed support/tolerance, or a previously identical query evicted from the bounded memo. Aggregate misses cannot distinguish these.
query_identity.saved_payload: Existing12 older M6 queries: six same-face/same-support previous pairs with changed coordinates; no reordered identical physical triangles. Not a current193 query-population census.

existing_support.behavior: HasAcceptedFaceCertificate checks oriented face/facet identity, exact BoundaryPoint coordinate/binding records and face/trace overrides. ExportParameters skips unchanged accepted coverage checks. This is association/coverage reuse, not a numeric distance certificate.

GeometryCertificates caches by accepted revision for incomplete/source enclosure queries; complete=true constructs the required full two-sided certificate. No per-face numeric substitute for complete union coverage.
Existing bounded exact FaceMemo retains numeric union upper bounds; prepared facet and scoped witness pools retain reusable immutable geometry with active-reference/resource accounting.

SmoothBoundary builds unchanged star/support/old merit once, retains projected context, lazily computes old geometry guidance once, screens validity and shape before MoveVertex, then fresh merit/heights/edges before candidate geometry. Rejected stars use existing context invalidation; reused counter is rejected-search reuse, not all context reuse.

Whole-patch geometry guidance retains face order and nonnegative partial-sum early rejection. Unchanged numeric faces can hit existing exact memo; changed candidate positions still need fresh evaluation.

Upper already uses exact finite footprints and rigorous plane/witness upper bounds, interval arithmetic, spatial candidates and full adaptive fallback. Build193 tightened this same envelope, not a duplicate framework.

motion_slack.proof: For paired affine triangle vertices against identical immutable target/support, distance-to-set is 1-Lipschitz: new one-sided upper <= outward(old upper + max paired displacement). This alone says nothing about association, orientation/features/bodies/heights or reverse coverage.
motion_slack.measured: ZERO of12 saved newer queries certified; six same-support pairs move1.51e-4..3.02e-4 versus slack1.98e-6..5.14e-5. Do not implement a motion index/cache on these inputs.

early_success_review.finding: TriangleUnion::Upper searches until best<=accuracy/4 although directed() accepts node.upper<=tolerance. All current Upper callers are the directed() lambda or SurfaceForest forwarding to its joined witness; active witness/mesh/model unions are constructed with actual query tolerance. Per-facet resolution-based unions are used for Distance, not Upper.
early_success_review.soundness: Plane/witness Upper already includes target piece approximation error and nominal-hull uncertainty padding. Any returned bound<=actual query tolerance proves that source domain. Returning a larger still-valid bound below tolerance preserves zero geometry hinge excess for the current guidance caller. Association/body/feature/height and full reverse/final gates remain independent.
early_success_review.quantitative_limit: BoundPhysicalSurface is a public numeric upper-bound API, not a minimum-distance estimate; nevertheless earlier exit can change returned numeric bounds, piece counts, retained results and resource usage. Equality between cached/recomputed behavior and all quantitative callers must be validated. No current counter says how much search happens after an adequate bound; NO speedup established.
early_success_review.next_evidence: If pursued within this same cycle, evaluate only a bounded earlier-success candidate against the existing12queries and affected geometry tests. Measure counted traversal, not wall alone. Reject or revise it if savings are absent or hard queries regress materially; no new old-code M6 baseline campaign.

constraints: No gate/time/work/memory increase, new config, duplicate cache/envelope, sampling acceptance or stale private context. Uncertain bounds fall back to existing full certification; CAD optional. Shape then residual geometry/size and shape reclosure remain required before transfer/continued CFD/disk restart. Goal remains two accepted Euler50k meshes then BL/MPI and RANS500k.
